北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴好但体感 5℃ 偏凉，记得添衣保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but feels cool at 5℃. Remember to dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有雨，体感 11℃ 稍凉，出门别忘带伞呀！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: It's rainy in Cixi, feels a bit cool at 11℃. Don't forget your umbrella!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海小雨微凉，体感 12℃，记得带伞出行哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai has light rain and feels cool at 12℃. Remember your umbrella!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴天暖和，体感 18℃ 很舒适，注意补水哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and warm, feels comfy at 18℃. Stay hydrated!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感 19℃ 温和，享受这宜人的天气吧！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels mild at 19℃. Enjoy this pleasant weather!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有雾，体感 11℃ 略凉，出行请注意交通安全！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy, feels cool at 11℃. Please be careful on the roads!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京大雾，体感 12℃，能见度低，开车请慢行！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has dense fog, feels like 12℃. Low visibility, drive slowly!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云体感 9℃，湿度大，记得防潮保暖哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like 9℃ with high humidity. Stay warm and mind dampness!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，体感 12℃，出门注意防潮和交通安全！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy, feels like 12℃. Mind dampness and traffic safety!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗体感 9℃，记得添衣，享受好天气哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and feels like 9℃. Remember to dress warmly and enjoy the good weather!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾，体感 12℃ 偏凉，出行注意安全哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy, feels cool at 12℃. Please be careful when going out!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 -4℃ 严寒，一定要多穿衣服，注意防风保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like a chilly -4℃. Dress warmly and protect yourself from wind and cold!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳体感 -4℃ 伴 4级 北风，注意防寒防风，别感冒！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang feels like -4℃ with 4-level north wind. Protect from cold and wind, don't catch a cold!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云体感 10℃，湿度高，早晚记得添衣哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feels like 10℃ with high humidity. Remember to add layers in morning/evening!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云体感 20℃ 宜人，户外活动很舒适，心情美美哒！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels pleasant at 20℃. Enjoy your outdoor activities!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云体感 7℃ 凉爽，出门注意添衣，别着凉哦！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and feels cool at 7℃. Remember to add layers and don't catch a cold!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云体感 2℃ 寒凉，记得多穿点，注意保暖防风！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels chilly at 2℃. Remember to layer up and stay warm from the wind!
